stage0001a:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$シン$$
「Look at that, everyone!
　It's our Earth!」

stage0001a:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$キラ$$
「We've really come back, haven't we...」

stage0001a:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$桂$$
「The 《$$破界事変$$》 and 《$$再世戦争$$》...
　A lot happened in that other world,
　but they're good memories now.」

stage0001a:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$シン$$
「The 《$$アビス$$》, that hole between dimensions,
　has closed. So we can't reach that world
　for a long while...」

stage0001a:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That doesn't mean we'll never see
　$$刹那$$ and $$ヒイロ$$ again.」

stage0001a:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Exactly.
　We'll do what we have to do
　here, in this world.」

stage0001a:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$桂$$
「Right.
　Starting with seeing the people who matter.」

stage0001a:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「What is it, $$ロジャー$$?」

stage0001a:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A return to peaceful days...
　Will we truly be granted that?」

stage0001a:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シン$$
「What that man 《$$アイム$$》 Liard said...」

stage0001a:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「He said those of us branded with it
　would go on being toyed with by fate.」

stage0001a:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But we still know nothing about
　what the 《$$烙印$$》 truly is.」

stage0001a:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「By $$アイム$$'s account, being branded
　with it is what threw us across
　into that other world...」

stage0001a:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What's wrong, Captain $$クワトロ$$...?!」

stage0001a:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$クワトロ$$
「...Stay sharp!
　Something is coming. Something
　we have never faced before!」
